def numDecodings(s):
    if not s or s[0] == '0': return 0
    n = len(s)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = dp[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        if s[i-1] != '0': dp[i] += dp[i-1]
        two = int(s[i-2:i])
        if 10 <= two <= 26: dp[i] += dp[i-2]
    return dp[n]
